question: Which one of the following is the 2ⁿd leading petroleum exporter in the world during 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saudi Arabia **has led the **world in annual oil exports**, but that **changed in 2019 **when the **United Arab Emirates overtook **it as the **world's biggest oil exporter**. 
 
• The **United States **has also **increased **its **share of global oil exports**, accounting **for 8.17% **of **exports in 2020**, up from **5.71% **in **2019**.
 
• **Russia takes **the **second spot**.
 
• In **2019**, it **accounted **for **11.6% **of global exports, totalling **$74.4 billion**.
 
• **Production reached **an annual **average of 10.5 million **barrels **per day**.
 
• **Produced by major names **like **Rosneft, Surgutneftegas, and Gazprom**. This accounts for **11% of global oil production**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Oil is the **third largest exported product **in the **world**, by revenue. In 2019, **crude petroleum accounted **for **3.82% **of **global trade**.
 
• **Crude oil **is unrefined **petroleum **that's used to **manufacture many products**, including **gasoline**, **heating fuel**, and **plastics**. As of 2019, **global oil production **reached **4.2 billion metric tons**.
 
• **Top countries list**:
 
 
• Saudi Arabia
 
• Russia
 
• United States
 
• Canada
 
• Iraq
 
• United Arab Emirates
 
• Nigeria
 
• Kuwait
 
• Kazakhstan
 
• Norway
